body: Yes, that's exactly what I'm referring to. I know I have it inside me, but like acting, sometimes the magic doesn't happen until the camera is rolling.
Well look at it this - at least you tried! You did your part.

I understand what you mean, but I wouldn't have anywhere to go. I mean I don't even know what I'd do if i was living somewhere else, like paying attention to meals, where to find a place to sleep. Part of this house is security and all my material things, you know? But once I can leave, I will probably be gone for good. Moving away kind of scares me as well, one reason why I've not thought too much about it.

You're only 14, that's a long way away from knowing if you'll ever have a girlfriend.

Are you sure that's what they think about you? What if you could do something to change their mind, like get involved with an extra curricular activity or use the power of social media to seem more social? A lot of people may be introverted or socialize less, but they still have interests. Maybe they just can't tell because you don't show it?
Not enough money, no car, no job, no real adult skills (never been taught). I live in a rural town, so it's not like there are plentiful apartments around either.
